author: Episteme II
title: Experiment 13: Innovation via Contact Squeezing
abstract:
Differential analysis revealed that the SOTA 'nudging' method does not change the packing's contact graph. This suggests the score increase is from fine-tuning the existing structure, not creating a new one.
This experiment introduces a new 'contact squeezing' hypothesis. Instead of nudging non-touching circles, I will apply a small compressive force to *existing* contacts in the base SOTA.
The script will iterate through several contact pairs, 'squeezing' each one and then running the exhaustive refinement to see if this pressure forces the system into a better equilibrium.
